points.why: Names arms race / mutual escalation, but frames it as a prisoner's dilemma and never describes balancing loops on relative position joining into a reinforcing loop.
Explains that a vendor who restrains while the other escalates loses sign-ups, so stopping alone fails.
Proposes changing what is competed on, plus public verifiable commitments that work only if the rival can verify them, rather than willpower.

pitfalls.why: Treats it as a mutual escalation trap, not ordinary reinforcing growth with a natural ceiling.
